frozen_implementation.role: typed public state, parameter, ledger, and synchronization API
independently written reduced ODE and delayed-feedback implementation
trajectory runner used by the qualification orchestrator

target.bounded_context: deterministic well-mixed flow-through reference coupled to one represented primary HUVEC

si_mapping.convention: The 44 kDa VEGF-A165a homodimer is one ligand amount. Molecule counts are divided by the exact Avogadro constant. The reduced 1:1 VEGFR2 association rate is converted from pM^-1 s^-1 using 1 pM = 1e-9 mol m^-3.

state_contract.balance_equation: initial_amount + cumulative_inlet = blood_free + endothelium_free + interstitium_free + receptor_bound + internalized + cleared_or_degraded + cumulative_outlet
state_contract.receptor_capacity_semantics: A fixed replenished VEGFR2 surface-site capacity bounds receptor_bound. Receptor production, unliganded trafficking, dimerization, phosphorylation, and explicit receptor recycling are outside this reduced ligand ledger.
state_contract.nrp1_choice: NRP1 is explicitly tracked-neutral in the reference candidate: its human identifier and full site eligibility are present, but no unsupported kinetic multiplier is introduced. Exclusion and a prospectively labelled 1.5-fold facilitation assumption are structural sensitivity variants only.

equations.equation: dI/dt = feedback*k_EI*E - k_IE*I - association + dissociation - clearance

reference_parameters.provenance: Sarabipour 2025 S16 reduced 1:1 VEGF-A165a to VEGFR2 binding
Sarabipour 2025 S16 reduced 1:1 VEGF-A165a to VEGFR2 binding
Sarabipour 2025 S14 threefold liganded VEGFR2 internalization
Sarabipour 2025 S12 4900 surface VEGFR2 per HUVEC

initial_state.interpretation: A pulse containing the source-encoded 6,843,182 VEGF-A165a homodimers starts in the blood-side owner; this is a flow-through software qualification case, not the source culture protocol.

synchronization.feedback_rule: Occupancy at the end of interval n schedules max(0.75, 1-0.25*occupancy) for endothelial-to-interstitial transport during interval n+1. Same-step mutation is forbidden.

evaluation.failure_policy: Retain failed, partial, and blocked gates. Do not mutate this protocol or exclude outputs after inspection; a changed candidate requires a new protocol version.

independent_evidence.use: direction and characteristic-time context only; HEK293T is not HUVEC
directional internalization and surface-loss check only; not a time-series fit

uncertainty_policy.numerical: Independent internal-step and coupling-interval refinements are mandatory.
uncertainty_policy.parameter: Report one-at-a-time plus/minus 10 percent local sensitivity; do not synthesize distributions.
uncertainty_policy.structural: Compare tracked-neutral NRP1, NRP1 exclusion, 1.5-fold labelled facilitation, and feedback-off variants.
uncertainty_policy.observational: No numeric experimental score is allowed until reusable values, transforms, errors, and covariance are frozen.
uncertainty_policy.correlation: Unknown; global probabilistic attribution and population prediction are blocked.
uncertainty_policy.identifiability: Transport assumptions are not identifiable from the selected receptor-trafficking observations and remain engineering parameters.

allowed_claim: The frozen MEHLISSA candidate is an independently written, SI-explicit, amount-conserving reduced VEGF-A165a/VEGFR2 HUVEC-informed dynamic coupling suitable for software, mathematical, numerical, and local-sensitivity qualification.
forbidden_claims: reimplementation or reproduction of the full 281-state source model
pulmonary endothelial, in vivo, patient-specific, diagnostic, treatment, safety, or clinical validity
globally identified parameter uncertainty or population prediction
independent human review before an external attestation exists
